repository.description: Outcome-locked, disease-blind single-cell analysis workflow for SLE B-cell remodeling and external validation.

releases.body:
# SLE B-cell remodeling analysis v1.0.0

This is the author-approved reproducible release supporting the manuscript:

> Disease-blind single-cell reconstruction separates unstable B-cell states from reproducible interferon remodeling in systemic lupus erythematosus

## Release contents

- Versioned analysis and audit code for the disease-blind single-cell workflow.
- Five publication main figures and seven supplementary figures.
- Machine-readable source data for all main figures.
- Complete gene-level statistical results, sanitized design matrices and regulator-sensitivity outputs.
- Final manuscript, supplementary information, cover letter and portal upload maps.
- Environment records, machine-readable decisions and SHA-256 integrity manifests.

## Scientific scope

The release supports a broad conventional-B identity scope, sample-level composition analysis, within-compartment IFN/ISG transcription, independent external validation and prespecified regulatory and perturbational evidence. The findings are observational and do not establish a discrete B-cell subtype, causal regulator, unique upstream stimulus or treatment benefit.

## Persistent identifier

Zenodo DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.22086892](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22086892)

## Licences

- Original code: MIT License.
- Original manuscript text, composite figures, project documentation and project-generated derived source tables: CC BY 4.0.
- Third-party GEO, CELLxGENE, database and software materials are excluded and are not relicensed.

See `LICENSE`, `LICENSE_CONTENT_CC_BY_4.0.md` and `LICENSE_SCOPE.md` for the controlling scope.

## Citation

Use the metadata in `CITATION.cff` or cite the Zenodo DOI above.

releases.body:
## Reproducibility release

This release mirrors the verified Zenodo archive at **https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22151739**. The source-code snapshot corresponds exactly to commit f1859ff8498d5569a1d5027b36ed18c8b7c7536f; the post-publication verification ledger is on main at 3d39835a76944a99769f5f1e0979647c25e39cef.

### Scientific boundaries

- QiTeng R2 is the author-confirmed scientific manuscript baseline.
- R1 remains HOLD_FULL_PIPELINE_TWO_COMPARTMENT_REPRODUCIBILITY; it is not rescued as PASS.
- C9R remains HOLD_C9A_PREFREEZE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
- Corrected external outcome unlock remains false; no corrected external disease effects were estimated.
- Regulatory analyses are observational and do not establish causal binding, a unique upstream ligand, or clinical utility.

The initial Zenodo version 10.5281/zenodo.22086892 has been withdrawn after verified replacement and now resolves to a tombstone. The concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22086891 resolves to this latest version.

### Files and licenses

- Research_Archive.zip: manuscript, supplementary material, figures, source data, R1/C9R evidence, provenance, and quality-control receipts.
- Source_Code.zip: exact Git archive of the release commit.
- SHA256SUMS.txt: SHA-256 checksums for both ZIP archives.

Original project code is licensed under MIT. Original manuscript content, composite figures, documentation, and project-generated derived source-data tables are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Third-party source resources retain their original terms.
